meta.title: Dense Retrieval Sequence - One Query, Ranked Chunks

cards.title: Happy path
items: The query text is encoded once, then searched; the first row of the vector is the query vector
Results come back as list[Retrieved] with chunk, score and rank starting at 1
The same DenseRetriever serves both entry points: python -m legalrag.eval and python -m legalrag.inspector

cards.title: Where the index lives
items: ChunkIndex owns Qdrant: recreate, upsert, search, get, count are the only operations callers see
Qdrant runs in local on-disk mode at {data_dir}/qdrant because Docker is not available
An empty index returns [] and metrics score 0.0, never NaN (Review Focus #1)

cards.title: Designed, not built
items: Hybrid BM25 retrieval and reciprocal rank fusion
Temporal filtering by an as_on date
Each drops in behind this same Retriever protocol, so Eval Runner and Inspector stay unchanged
